title: chelone glabra var. typica
intro: Chelone glabra var. typica, commonly known as the White Turtlehead, is a plant species native to North America. This perennial wildflower is known for its unique, turtle-head shaped flowers and its potential health benefits. Chelone glabra var. typica has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including colds, sore throats, and respiratory infections, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which may contribute to its health benefits.
